source.snippet: AI Agent Bankrupted Their Operator While Trying to Scan DN42. Tags: devops, networking, vibecoding. Score 8.

problem_statement: AI coding/devops agents can run up unexpected large cloud or API bills when given autonomous tasks with broad permissions, leaving operators with no cost guardrails or kill-switch in place before damage is done.
target_segment: Solo developers, indie hackers, and small engineering teams deploying AI agents for devops or network automation tasks.
notes: Story resonated (score 8 on Lobsters) and is recent (2026-06-12). Pain is financial and acute — operators lost real money. A cost-cap / circuit-breaker service or SDK for AI agents would directly address this. Buyer is a developer or small team already spending on AI API usage. Explicit monetary loss signals strong willingness to pay for prevention.
